arStrings.szText:
Dealing {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} different types of Non-Physical damage increases the Potency of your {c_important}Imbuement{/c} Skills by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*Affix."Static Value 1"|%x|]{/c} and Non-Physical damage by {c_number}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} seconds. 

{c_important}Basic{/c} Skills are now {c_important}Imbuable{/c}.
